item.text: I’ll implement the indexing with an explicit validity mask so invalid values are never used to gather from `x`, including extreme `int32` indices.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "rg --files -g '"'!*__pycache__*'"' -g '"'!*.pyc'"' && (test -f AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md || true) && (test -f README.md && sed -n '1,200p' README.md || true)"
